n-m-e3-s2b-01.title: Kugadzira nhamba iri pakati pe pizza imwe ne pizza mbiri nema fractions ane denominator imwechete
n-m-e3-s2b-01.topic: Fractions (improper fractions ne unit fractions, hukuru hwema fractions: fractions pakati pe 1 ne 2)
n-m-e3-s2b-01.goal: Tarisa nemienzaniso yakati wandei kuti numerator ye fraction ine denominator imwechete inoita kuti ive yakakura kupfuura 1 uye shoma kupfuura 2 apo, uye utaure kuti fractions dzemuganhu dzinoenda kudivi ripi.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.material: Boka raSeoa rinogovana pizza yakachekwa kuita zvidimbu zvakaenzana. Kana pizza imwe yagovaniswa zvakaenzana kuita zvidimbu 4, chidimbu chimwe i 1/4 ye pizza. Tinonyora zvidimbu 3 se 3/4 pizza uye zvidimbu 5 se 5/4 pizza. Fraction ine numerator hombe kupfuura denominator inonzi improper fraction.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.thinking.0: Kusarudza kana mitengo yemuganhu (pizza imwe chaizvo, pizza mbiri chaizvo) inogutsa mamiriro
n-m-e3-s2b-01.thinking.1: Kugadzira nekutarisa mienzaniso nenzira imwechete kune ma denominators akati wandei
n-m-e3-s2b-01.thinking.2: Kuverenga mienzaniso uye kutarisa kuti hapana inosiiwa kana kuverengwa kakawanda
n-m-e3-s2b-01.prereq.0: Kuverenga fraction sezvose nechikamu (3 pa 4, nezvimwewo)
n-m-e3-s2b-01.prereq.1: Kuziva improper fractions nema mixed numbers
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s1.prompt: Pizza imwe yakagovaniswa zvakaenzana kuita zvidimbu 4. Ndeipi pama fractions anotevera iri yakawanda kupfuura pizza imwe?
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s1.hint.0: Dhonza mufananidzo, ugovanise pizza imwe kuita zvidimbu 4, uye uite shading huwandu hwezvidimbu pasarudzo imwe neimwe.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa huwandu hwezvidimbu mu pizza imwe nehuwandu hwezvidimbu musarudzo imwe neimwe, padivi pedivi.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s1.r.a: Zvidimbu 3 hazvina kuzadza pizza imwe yose, asi unogona kunge wakafunga kuti yakawanda nekungotarisa huwandu hwezvidimbu.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s1.r.b: Kufunga uku kunoverenga fraction iri huwandu humwechete ne pizza imwe se "yakawanda kupfuura pizza imwe."
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s1.r.c: Kufunga uku kwakawana mamiriro apo huwandu hwezvidimbu hwakawanda kupfuura huwandu hwezvidimbu zvinoita pizza imwe.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s1.r.d: Kufunga uku kwakaona seyakawanda kunyange huwandu hwezvidimbu hushoma. Zvidimbu zvingani zvinoita pizza imwe?
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s1.explain: Pizza imwe i zvidimbu 4. Zvidimbu 5 i pizza imwe (zvidimbu 4) nechidimbu 1, saka i yakawanda kupfuura pizza imwe. Zvidimbu 4 i pizza imwe chaizvo, uye zvidimbu 3 kana zvidimbu 2 i shoma kupfuura pizza imwe.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza denominator kubva ku 3 kusvika ku 9 uye ugadzire improper fractions a/b 4 dzakasiyana dzakawanda kupfuura pizza imwe uye shoma kupfuura pizza mbiri. (Denominator i b uye numerator i a.)
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza denominator uye utanga wanyora kuti pizza imwe yagovaniswa kuita zvidimbu zvingani.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora huwandu hwezvidimbu mu pizza imwe nemu pizza mbiri, uye usarudze numerator iri pakati.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.hint.2: Kune fraction yega yega yawakagadzira, tarisa nekuenzanisa numerator nehuwandu hwezvidimbu mu pizza imwe nemu pizza mbiri.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Denominator i natural number kubva ku 3 kusvika ku 9.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Ndapota ita b natural number kubva ku 3 kusvika ku 9.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Numerator i hombe kupfuura denominator, saka i yakawanda kupfuura pizza imwe.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Inofanira kuva yakawanda kupfuura pizza imwe. Numerator inofanira kuva hombe kupfuura denominator (huwandu hwezvidimbu mu pizza imwe).
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Inofanira kuva shoma kupfuura pizza mbiri. Numerator inofanira kuva shoma kupfuura ka2 yehuwandu hwezvidimbu mu pizza imwe.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.explain: Kana denominator i b, pizza imwe i zvidimbu b. Kana numerator i hombe kupfuura b uye shoma kupfuura 2b, inogutsa mamiriro. Kana numerator yakaenzana ne b kana 2b, i pizza imwe chaizvo kana pizza mbiri chaizvo, saka inosiiwa pamamiriro e "yakawanda uye shoma".
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s3.prompt: Pakati pema fractions ane denominator 6, mangani ari akawanda kupfuura pizza imwe uye shoma kupfuura pizza mbiri zvose?
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora ma fractions ane denominator 6 nenhevedzano, ane ma numerators kubva ku 5 kusvika ku 13.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s3.hint.1: Bvisa dzinova pizza imwe chaizvo nepizza mbiri chaizvo, uye uverenge dzasara.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s3.r.a: Kufunga uku kwakaverenga fraction imwe yakawanda iri pamuganhu, kana pizza imwe kana pizza mbiri.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s3.r.b: Kufunga uku kwakaverengawo ma fractions akaenzana ne pizza imwe nepizza mbiri.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s3.r.c: Kufunga uku kwakasiya fraction imwe inogutsa mamiriro. Nyora ma numerators nenhevedzano kutanga nehukuru kupfuura 6.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s3.r.d: Kufunga uku kwakasiya mimuganhu uye kwakaverenga numerator yega yega iri pakati payo.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s3.explain: Kune 5, ane ma numerators 7, 8, 9, 10, ne 11. 6/6 i pizza imwe chaizvo uye 12/6 i pizza mbiri chaizvo, saka hadzisanganisirwi.

n-m-e3-s1-04.thinking.1: Shandura kutonga kwako zvichienderana neruzivo rutsva
n-m-e3-s1-04.thinking.2: Gadzira iwe pachako nyaya apo kufungidzira kwakanganisa
n-m-e3-s1-04.s.s1.prompt: Pese painobuda ruzivo rutsva, sarudza kuti kufunga kwako kunoshanduka sei.
n-m-e3-s1-04.s.s1.hint.0: Padanho rega rega, tanga waenzanisa kana kufungidzira kwaHaram kwakakura kana kudiki kupfuura huremu chaihwo.
n-m-e3-s1-04.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora nhamba dzakafungidzirwa padivi penhamba chaidzo uye uverenge kuti musiyano unounganidzwa kangani.

n-m-e3-s1-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ndinotenda kuti 600 iri pasi pe 700, saka mabhokisi 3 anogona kuiswa

n-m-e3-s1-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Kufungidzira kunobatsirawo. Chinokosha kutarisa kuti kufungidzira kupi kunowirirana nemubvunzo upi.
n-m-e3-s1-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Sezvo yakatenderedzwa kudzika kusvika 200, huremu chaihwo hunogona kuva hukuru, saka tinofanira kuziva zvakawanda

n-m-e3-s1-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Mabhokisi akawanda, huwandu hwakarasika hunounganidzwa nguva dzakawanda. Verenga kuti chii chinounganidzwa kana pane mabhokisi 3.

n-m-e3-s1-03.title: Kupatsanura kunofanana kana ukachinja kutevedzana, seekuwanza here?

n-m-e3-s1-03.prereq.1: Ziva kuti kupatsanura kunoreva kugovanisa zvakaenzana
n-m-e3-s1-03.prereq.2: Mukuwanza, product yakafanana kana ukachinja kutevedzana

n-m-e3-s1-03.s.s1.o.b: Kuti kuchinja kutevedzana kunopa mhinduro imwe chete mukuwanza here kunofanira kutariswa zvakasiyana nekuti kunoitika mukupatsanura.
